blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Parallel speculative decoders propose an entire token block at once, yet one early inconsistency can cause the target to reject its remaining suffix. We introduce Corrective Prefix Attention (CPA), which combines prefix-aware selection with autoregressive supervision to improve these parallel drafts. CPA lets each candidate attend to earlier choices within the block. Fixed candidate shortlists allow all pairwise interactions to be computed before selection, reducing the sequential walk to table lookups, accumulation and lightweight scoring rather than repeated neural evaluations. An auxiliary autoregressive loss trains the shared backbone on clean prefixes without adding an inference pass. Across eight math, code and dialogue benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B targets on Ascend NPUs, CPA commits 13--15\% more tokens per verification round than DSpark and 25--26\% more than DFlash. Its mean speedups reach $3.35\times$ and $3.37\times$ under greedy decoding and $2.86\times$ under sampling for both targets. Ablations support both components, while capacity sweeps demonstrate that greater acceptance alone does not guarantee faster decoding. These results motivate correcting parallel proposals with causal information while keeping sequential computation inexpensive.
blocks.zh: 平行的投机解码器同时提出一个完整的符号块,然而一个早期的不一致会导致目标拒绝其剩余的后缀. 我们引入了修正前缀注意(CPA),将前缀感知选择和自递式监督结合起来,改进这些平行的草稿. 《全面和平协定》允许每位候选人在街区内参加较早的选择。 固定候选人短名单允许在甄选前计算所有对偶互动,从而减少按顺序走进桌边看、积累和轻量级评分,而不是重复的神经评价。 辅助自动递减器在清洁前缀上对共享主干线进行列车,但不增加推论通行证. Ascend NPU上的Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B目标在8个数学、代码和对话基准中, CPA承诺每轮核查比DSpark多13-15++++x, 它的平均速度在贪婪的解码下达到3.35\time$和3.37\time$,在两个目标的取样下达到2.86\time$. 缩写支持两个组件,而容量扫描显示,单凭接受程度提高并不能保证更快的解码. 这些结果促使用因果信息纠正平行建议,同时使顺序计算费用低廉。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Speculative decoding speeds up a large language model by letting a cheap drafter propose tokens that the target model then checks in a single forward pass ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . Autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3 run once per proposed token ( Li et al., 2025 ) , so long drafts are expensive. Parallel drafters remove this cost. Building on blockwise parallel decoding ( Stern et al., 2018 ) , DFlash conditions a small block model on target features and predicts every position of a block in one pass ( Chen et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: Speculative解码加快了大型语言模型的速度,让一个廉价的起草者提出令牌,目标模型再以一通前传检查(Leviathan等,2023;Chen等,2023). EAGLE-3等自动后退式起草器每被提议代币运行一次(Li等,2025年),因此长发的起草费很昂贵. 并行的起草者删除了这一成本 。 以区块平行解码(Stern等,2018年)为基础,DFlash在目标特征上为小区块模型提供条件并预测区块在一通中的每一位置(Chen等,2026a). 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Parallel drafting, however, is at odds with how drafts are verified. The target accepts proposals only up to the first token it disagrees with and discards the rest ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ) . Speed is therefore governed by where the first error occurs, and an early error costs far more than a late one. Yet a parallel drafter scores every position before any position has been chosen.
blocks.zh: 然而,平行的起草工作与草案的核查方式不一致。 目标只接受它不同意和抛弃其他建议的第一个标志(Leviathan等人,2023年)。 因此,速度受第一次出错发生地点的制约,早期出错的代价远不止迟到. 然而,在选择任何职位之前,每个职位都有一个平行的起草者评分。

blocks.en: Consider a block in which the candidates are they or she at one position, often at the next, and run or runs at the third. The correct verb depends on the subject two positions back. A position-wise argmax cannot react to the subject it actually chose. A correction that looks only at the previous token sees often on both paths and cannot tell them apart. An autoregressive drafter sees the whole prefix, but pays a backbone step for every token.
blocks.zh: 考虑一个街区,让候选人在一个职位上,经常在下一个职位上,在第三个职位上跑或跑。 正确的动词取决于主题的回两个位置. 位置的正方形无法对它实际选择的主题作出反应。 仅看上一个符号的校正经常在两条道上看到,无法将它们分开. 自动后退的起草者看到整个前缀,但为每个符号支付一个主干步骤.

blocks.en: Recent work therefore adds a correction stage after the parallel pass. DFlash 2 rescores adjacent candidate pairs ( Inco AI, 2026 ) ; Domino and DSpark run a recurrent or Markov head through the block ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) ; D-Loop conditions another backbone pass on the selected prefix ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . These designs trade context against sequential computation: local rescoring is cheap but sees one token, while recurrent heads and repeated passes see more of the prefix at the price of neural computation at every position.
blocks.zh: 因此,最近的工作在平行通过之后增加了一个纠正阶段。 DFlash 2 recore相邻的候选对(Inco AI, 2026);多米诺和DSpark通过区块运行一个常态或马尔可夫头(Huang等, 2026;Cheng等, 2026);D-Loop条件在所选前缀上再传递一个骨干(Chen等, 2026b). 这些设计贸易上下文与相继计算相对:本地回分很便宜,但看到一个符号,而反复出现的头和重复的过关则看到以每个位置的神经计算价格为代价的更多前缀.

blocks.en: We show that attention-style correction does not need this trade-off. After the parallel pass, each position has a fixed shortlist of candidates. The interaction between a candidate at position i i and a candidate at an earlier position j j then depends only on those two tokens and on block features that are already computed, not on which path is eventually chosen. All such interactions can be computed together in one batched step. Attention over the selected prefix then reduces exactly to gathering and accumulating table entries as choices are made, and the sequential walk contains no neural network evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们表明,关注式的纠正不需要这种取舍。 平行通过后,每个职位都有固定的候选人短名单. i位候选人和j位候选人在j位较早时的交互作用,则只取决于已经计算出的两个符号和块特性,而不是最终选择的路径. 所有这些相互作用都可以分批计算。 对所选前缀的注意,然后随着选择的作出,精确地减少到表项的收集和积累,相继行走没有神经网络的评价.

blocks.en: Corrective Prefix Attention ( CPA ) builds on this observation and uses prefix information once more during training (Figure 1 ). A parallel drafter only ever learns from masked blocks, so its backbone never practices predicting the next token from a correct prefix, which is exactly the situation that verification rewards. CPA runs the shared backbone a second time on clean, causally masked prefixes and adds a next-token loss over the full vocabulary. This pass exists only during training; inference still runs a single parallel pass.
blocks.zh: 校正前缀注意(CPA)以这一观察为基础,并在训练期间再次使用前缀信息(图1). 一个平行的起草者只从被遮住的块中学习过,因此它的骨干从不从正确的前缀中去预测下个符号,这正是核查奖励的情况. CPA第二次在干净的、因果被掩盖的前缀上运行共享骨干,并在全部词汇中增加下接的丢失. 这个通行证只在训练期间才存在;推论中仍然有一个平行通行证.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • A selector that attends over all earlier choices in a drafted block, compiled exactly into precomputed candidate-pair tables so that the sequential walk performs only lookups and additions (Section 3 ). • An auxiliary autoregressive objective that trains the shared parallel backbone on clean prefixes at no inference cost. • An evaluation on eight benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B targets on Ascend 910B2 NPUs, in which CPA has the highest mean speedup at both temperatures and commits 13–15% more tokens per round than DSpark. Attending to older choices raises acceptance and speed by about 5% over a local-only selector with similar inferred round cost, the autoregressive loss improves both on all eight benchmarks, and capacity sweeps show when more acceptance stops paying for its cost.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Speculative decoding verifies drafted tokens with the target model and, with rejection sampling, preserves its output distribution ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . Autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3 reuse target features and produce one token per drafter step ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Blockwise drafters instead predict a whole block at once ( Stern et al., 2018 ) . DFlash conditions a small block model on target hidden states ( Chen et al., 2026a ) , and DFlare changes how drafter layers access those features ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . CPA keeps the DFlash backbone and changes two things: how a path is selected from its proposals, and how the backbone is trained.
blocks.zh: 光谱解码用目标模型验证所起草的代币,并用拒绝抽样来保存其产出分布(Leviathan等,2023;Chen等,2023)。 EAGLE-3再利用目标特征等自动回放式起草器,并每个起草器步骤产生一个令牌(Li等,2025. ). 阻断起草者则一并预测整个块(Stern等人,2018年). DFlash在目标隐藏状态(Chen等,2026a)上为小块模型条件,而DFlare会改变起草器层如何获取这些特征(Zhang等,2026年). CPA保持了DFlash主干线,并改变两件事:如何从建议中选择一条路径,以及如何培训主干线.

blocks.en: Kim et al. (2024) show that independent per-position predictions can be improved by searching a top- k k lattice with a rescoring language model. DFlash 2 scores adjacent candidate pairs within top-16 shortlists and walks the precomputed scores ( Inco AI, 2026 ) ; this corresponds to the local term of CPA . Domino corrects the parallel logits with a recurrent head trained under a curriculum ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , and DSpark combines a sequential correction head with confidence-based verification scheduling ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . D-Loop reruns the backbone conditioned on a selected prefix ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , and DDTree verifies a tree of branches rather than a single path ( Ringel and Romano, 2026 ) . CPA sits between local rescoring and recurrent correction. It attends over all earlier choices, as a recurrent head can, but each attention interaction involves one pair of fixed candidates, so every interaction is computed before selection begins and the sequential walk only gathers results.

blocks.en: Domino feeds reference tokens to its correction head during training ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Joint autoregressive and diffusion objectives have been used to train a model that drafts and verifies its own output ( Fu et al., 2026 ) . CPA applies a clean-prefix objective to the shared backbone of a separate drafter for a frozen target. The causal pass is a training signal only and does not run at inference.
blocks.zh: 多米诺在训练期间为其校正头提供参考标志(Huang等,2026.). 采用联合自动递减和传播目标来培训一种起草和核实自身产出的模式(Fu等人,2026年)。 会计师协会将一个干净的前置目标适用于一个被冻结的目标单独起草者的共同骨干。 因果传出只是训练信号,不进行推断.

blocks.en: Acceptance length and wall-clock speed can disagree: a slower drafter can accept more tokens and still reduce throughput ( Yan et al., 2025 ) . Following CORAL and DFlash ( Weng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) , we report both quantities at temperatures zero and one, and we relate them through the time a verification round takes.
blocks.zh: 接受长度和墙钟速度可能存在分歧:一个较慢的起草者可以接受更多的信使并仍然会减少吞吐量(Yan等,2025.). 继CORAL和DFlash(Weng等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年a)之后,我们报告在零和一温度下的数量,并在核查回合所需时间内将它们联系起来。

blocks.en: The target scores the proposed path in one causal forward pass. Under greedy decoding we commit the longest prefix that matches the target’s choices, plus the target’s token at the first mismatch, or a bonus token if all m m proposals match. This reproduces greedy target decoding exactly, whatever the draft quality (Proposition 4). At temperature one, the proposal is still a deterministic path: CPA returns the selected token IDs without draft probabilities. We verify it with the standard rejection sampler of vLLM, which treats each proposal as a point mass. Proposal y ^ i \hat{y}_{i} is accepted with its probability under the processed target distribution; on rejection, y ^ i \hat{y}_{i} is removed from that distribution and a token is sampled from the renormalized remainder. Approximate entropy-based verification and block verification are disabled. This preserves the target distribution ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: We use Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) as frozen targets with thinking mode disabled, and evaluate on eight benchmarks: GSM8K, MATH-500 and AIME 2025 for mathematics; HumanEval, MBPP and LiveCodeBench for code; and MT-Bench and Alpaca for dialogue ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Hugging Face H4, 2024 ; Dekoninck et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Austin et al., 2021 ; Jain et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ; Taori et al., 2023 ) . All methods use the same evaluation prompts and decoding settings; Appendix F lists the shared dataset versions and splits. We decode at temperatures 0 and 1 with top- p = 1 p=1 and no top- k k truncation, generating at most 2,048 new tokens per request. We compare with target-only autoregressive decoding, the parallel drafters DFlash ( Chen et al., 2026a ) and DSpark ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) , and the autoregressive drafter EAGLE-3 ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Every drafter proposes 15 tokens per round, matching block size 16. DSpark’s confidence-based scheduling is disabled, so all methods use the same fixed proposal budget.

blocks.en: We train all drafters, including EAGLE-3, from scratch for five epochs for each target on the same OpenPerfectBlend prompts with target-generated responses. The CPA drafter uses the DFlash backbone architecture with the target, token embeddings and vocabulary head frozen. The reference configuration uses K = 16 K=16 candidates, rank r = 256 r=256 , four heads, one selector layer, α max = 0.5 \alpha_{\max}=0.5 and λ AR = 0.2 \lambda_{\rm AR}=0.2 ; Appendix C lists all settings. Training uses eight Ascend 910B2 NPUs: six data-parallel training workers and two that generate target hidden states. On Qwen3-4B, one epoch takes 17 hours for DFlash, 23 for DSpark, 28 for CPA and 34 for EAGLE-3. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Parallel drafters are fast because they score every position at once, but verification rewards a block that is consistent from its first token onward. CPA reconciles the two. Its selector attends over every earlier choice in the block, and because the shortlists are fixed, all of that attention can be computed before selection begins, leaving a sequential walk of lookups and additions. An auxiliary autoregressive loss gives the shared backbone practice at predicting from correct prefixes at no inference cost. Attention to older choices accounts for most of the selector’s speed gain while keeping inferred round cost similar. Across eight benchmarks, two target sizes and two temperatures, CPA commits 13–15% more tokens per round than DSpark and has the highest mean speedup in every setting. The capacity sweeps carry a broader lesson for draft correction: added context helps only as long as it stays cheaper than the tokens it saves.
blocks.zh: 平行起草者很快,因为他们一次打出每个位置的分数,但核查奖励一个块,这个块从第一个标志开始是一致的。 《全面和平协议》调和了两者。 由于短名单是固定的,因此所有注意力都可以在甄选开始前计算,留下一系列的观察和补充。 辅助自旋性损失在不产生推论成本的情况下从正确的前缀中预测出共享骨干实践. 注意旧的选择占了选择者的大部分速度收益,同时保持所推断的圆通费用类似. 在8个基准、2个目标大小和2个温度中,美国航天公司每轮比DSpark公司多出13-15%的代币,并且每场比赛的平均速度都最高。 能力扫描为校正草案提供了更广泛的经验教训:增加的上下文只有当它比它节省的道具更便宜时才有用。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We evaluate two targets from one model family, Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, and run the ablations on Qwen3-4B only. The reported throughput results use one accelerator type, the Ascend 910B2, with vLLM-Ascend. The stage breakdown uses synchronization at each measured boundary and characterizes the instrumented execution; throughput and speedup use separate runs with instrumentation disabled. All methods use a fixed model-specific AR throughput reference, so individual workload ratios are relative to that reference rather than to a separately measured AR throughput for that workload. The relative cost of the sequential selection walk depends on kernel-launch overheads and may differ on GPUs or other serving stacks, so the speedups should not be transferred directly to other hardware. We report single training runs and do not give confidence intervals over retraining or repeated timing; sub-percent differences, such as 3.35 × 3.35\times against 3.34 × 3.34\times , do not establish a reliable ranking without repeated measurements. Appendix C documents the training recipe and seed roles; final resumption budgets, training-data revisions and evaluated checkpoint identifiers are not available in the accompanying run metadata.

blocks.en: The selector can only choose among the top- K K candidates of the parallel pass, so a target token outside the shortlist ends the accepted prefix regardless of the selector. Table construction grows quadratically with the shortlist size and the block length, which limits how far either can be increased; our capacity sweeps show this cost overtaking the acceptance gain at K = 32 K=32 . The no-AR drafter was trained in a separate run, so factors other than λ AR \lambda_{\rm AR} may contribute to the gap. The auxiliary causal pass and the selector make training more expensive: on Qwen3-4B, one CPA epoch takes 28 hours on our hardware, against 17 for DFlash and 23 for DSpark. The AR-loss ablation compares drafters at the same number of epochs, not the same compute budget. The selector is trained on recorded prefixes rather than its own choices, so some exposure mismatch remains.

blocks.en: The equivalence of compiled and direct selection, and of greedy speculative and target decoding, holds in exact arithmetic. In BF16, changes in summation order can flip decisions near ties, so deployments should check output parity on their own kernels.
blocks.zh: 汇编和直接选择的等同性,以及贪婪的投机和目标解码,都具有精确的算术性。 在BF16中,总和顺序的改变可以将决定翻转到联系附近,因此部署应该在自己的内核上检查输出等分.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: CPA accelerates a fixed target model and does not change what it generates under greedy decoding or, with the sampler we use, its output distribution. It therefore neither mitigates nor adds to the target’s risks, such as factual errors or biased outputs. Faster decoding can lower the energy cost per generated token, but we did not measure training or serving energy. All benchmarks are public and used under their licenses.
blocks.zh: CPA加速一个固定的目标模型,不会改变它在贪婪的解码下产生的东西,或者用我们的采样器来改变它的输出分布. 因此,它既不减轻也不增加目标的风险,例如事实错误或偏颇的产出。 更快的解码可以降低每个生成符的能耗,但我们没有测量训练或服务能. 所有基准都是公开的,并在其许可证下使用。

Starting from a committed context, accept the longest proposed prefix matching those target decisions. If a mismatch occurs, append the target decision at that position; if the full block matches, append the target’s next decision as a bonus. Stop immediately at EOS and obey the remaining output budget. The committed output is identical to serial target greedy decoding.

blocks.en: Proof. The first verified position is evaluated under the committed context. Each accepted match extends that context by exactly the serial target decision, so induction establishes equality at every accepted position. At a given step, suppose compiled and direct scores differ by at most δ \delta per candidate under the same preceding choices. blocks.en: The local_prefix_v2 implementation supports a stacked variant with two independently parameterized cross-attention blocks. At rank 256, each block uses pre-attention query LayerNorm and four 64-dimensional heads, with query, key, value and output projections followed by a residual connection. A pre-FFN LayerNorm and a → → 256 256\!\to\!512\!\to\!256 feed-forward network with SiLU form a second residual branch. Let q ( 0 ) q^{(0)} be the candidate query and M M the older selected-prefix memory. The blocks operate sequentially: q ( 1 ) = F 1 ​ ( q ( 0 ) , M ) , q ( 2 ) = F 2 ​ ( q ( 1 ) , M ) . q^{(1)}=F_{1}(q^{(0)},M),\qquad q^{(2)}=F_{2}(q^{(1)},M). (28) Both blocks attend to the same memory, which is not updated between layers. The memory excludes the immediate predecessor, whose contribution remains in the separate local term. The history correction is h = w out ⊤ ​ ( q ( 2 ) − q ( 0 ) ) , h=w_{\mathrm{out}}^{\top}\bigl(q^{(2)}-q^{(0)}\bigr), (29) and is added to the unary score and local correction. blocks.en: Each worker keeps a first-in, first-out buffer of at most 32 detached training examples with their shortlists, adding up to four anchors per step. Before a selector update, a BF16 copy of the selector greedily selects paths on these examples and records the protected prefix , the leading choices that equal the cached greedy target. The guard saves the selector parameters ϕ t \phi_{t} and optimizer state, then performs one AdamW step, updating the first and second moments and incrementing the optimizer step counter. Let Δ \Delta be the resulting parameter displacement and g g the gradient of the shortlist cross-entropy on the protected positions. The guard applies the stabilized projection Δ stab = Δ − max ⁡ ( g ⊤ ​ Δ , 0 ) max ⁡ ( ‖ g ‖ 2 2 , ϵ ) ​ g , \Delta_{\mathrm{stab}}=\Delta-\frac{\max(g^{\top}\Delta,0)}{\max(\|g\|_{2}^{2},\epsilon)}g, (32) with ϵ = 10 − 30 \epsilon=10^{-30} . An accepted update sets ϕ t + 1 = ϕ t + s ​ Δ stab \phi_{t+1}=\phi_{t}+s\Delta_{\mathrm{stab}} and retains the updated AdamW moments and incremented step counter unchanged. Only the parameter displacement is scaled; moments are neither scaled nor recomputed. Backtracking trials perform no additional optimizer steps and do not increment the counter again. The learning-rate schedule follows training iterations, including iterations whose selector update is rejected. The guard starts at step 4,000, affects the selector only and adds no inference cost.
